# EffectfulJS local adaptations

Sources come from the latest 2026-10-11 npm distributions of `@effectful/core`, `@effectful/debugger`, and `@effectful/serialization` (2.0.12), from https://github.com/awto/effectfuljs. Their MIT licenses are retained. These are production source dependencies, not package caches.

`core` keeps the upstream compiler and replaces workspace dependency metadata with exact versions; Babel dependencies use the current 8.x release. `serialization` corrects unnamed symbol registration and restores data properties without invoking inherited setters while the graph is incomplete. Array properties preserve holes, length, additional keys, and prototypes. Dedicated primitive descriptors preserve negative zero and both infinities through JSON encoding.

`continuations` is the dependency closure of the debugger's continuation runtime, without its UI, transport, precompiled third-party packages, or runtime compiler. Function registration accepts a factory emitted by Bear Forge's compiler instead of using Function. Eval/compiler entry points are unavailable, automatic host timers are disabled, and debugger options are disabled. Persistent bound functions retain constructor behavior. Closure persistence records the captured variable array separately from the frame's current variable array; restoration fills inline captures after graph creation. Function prototype chains preserve lowered class inheritance. Saving bound async frames does not modify their live links. Exported program objects and schema closures are serialized as ordinary graph roots, rather than registered as opaque module exports. This preserves one shared module environment for restored execution and schema validation; the compiled ABI is effectful-v2-static-2.

Bear Forge supplies an explicit IO device, serializable deterministic promise jobs, realm-local builtins, and array iterators. These changes are validated by native/compiled differential and snapshot/fork tests. An upstream version number is not a claim that all required tests have passed; progress is tracked only in docs/plan.md.
